translationRepairs: On jiyou his illness turned critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juyi, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
On jiyou his illness turned critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juzheng, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
Chinese 張居正 is Zhang Juzheng; the idiomatic Zhang Juyi is a mistransliteration of the same name, and the proposed replacement is otherwise accurate.
Day jiyou: his illness became critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juyi, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
Day jiyou: his illness became critical; Grand Secretaries Gao Gong, Zhang Juzheng, and Gao Yi were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.
Chinese 張居正 is Zhang Juzheng; the literal Zhang Juyi is a mistransliteration, and the proposed replacement is otherwise accurate.
On guimao raiders attacked Datong and Vice Regional Commander Qian Dong was killed in battle.
On guiwei raiders attacked Datong and Vice Regional Commander Qian Dong was killed in battle.
Chinese day is 癸未 (guiwei); guimao would be 癸卯. Preceding 壬午 and following 戊子 also confirm the sequential reading as guiwei.
Day guimao: raiders violated Datong; Vice Regional Commander Qian Dong died in battle.
Day guiwei: raiders violated Datong; Vice Regional Commander Qian Dong died in battle.
Chinese day is 癸未 (guiwei); the literal guimao misreads 未 as 卯, and the proposed guiwei is the correct reading.
